FN-L55G4WA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 355
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 355 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Crime Victims
Compensation Commission by a commission-estimated $22,000 annually by extending the time
allowed for an individual to file a claim for compensation from one year after the injury or death
of an individual, under current law, to two years, as provided by this bill.
